subject: Advanced: Save Mouseclick in Plot as Data

messages.author: bf524a8c0f86fec6
messages.subject: Advanced: Save Mouseclick in Plot as Data
parts:
Hey everybody,
I have the following dream and question:

I have a plot of 2-dimensional dataset and I want give the user the possibility to add data by clicking on the plot exactly where
the new data point should be produced.
(The user clicks on the plot at (10, 10) where no data point is existing and then a point with coordinates 10,10 is added to the dataset.)

Is it possible in general to write such a function e.g. in Java and combine that with R Shiny.


Thank you very much!

Andreas

messages.author: 55771919c42cb6a1
messages.subject: Re: Advanced: Save Mouseclick in Plot as Data
parts:
Something like this?
http://glimmer.rstudio.com/winstontest/locator/

This example responds to both click and hover events (when the mouse cursor is in the same spot for 150ms).

Source at:
https://github.com/wch/testapp/tree/master/locator

-Winston
